source_caption:
To make Tony’s explosive anger feel as authentic as possible in The Sopranos, James Gandolfini deliberately made himself miserable before filming certain scenes.

Gandolfini had a variety of methods he used to get into character. “I’ll do a lot of weird things; bang my head on things. And when I had to look irritable I would put rocks in my shoes. It would hurt my feet and it helped me to get mad. Or sleep two or three hours a night for two nights before you have a scene. Every single thing that anyone does will piss you off,” he said.
